1f:["$","$L29","pre-0",{"node":{"type":"element","tagName":"pre","properties":{},"children":[{"type":"element","tagName":"code","properties":{"className":["language-python"]},"children":[{"type":"text","value":"case = []\n\nwhile True:\n    test = list(map(int, input().split()))\n    if test == [0, 0, 0]:\n        break\n    else:\n        case.append(test)\n\nfor i, (L, P, V) in enumerate(case):\n    total = V // P * L\n    if V % P >= L:\n        total += L\n    else:\n        total += (V % P)\n    print(f\"Case {i+1}: {total}\")\n"}],"position":{"start":{"line":33,"column":1,"offset":1551},"end":{"line":50,"column":4,"offset":1874}}}],"position":{"start":{"line":33,"column":1,"offset":1551},"end":{"line":50,"column":4,"offset":1874}}},"children":["$","code","code-0",{"className":"language-python","children":"case = []\n\nwhile True:\n    test = list(map(int, input().split()))\n    if test == [0, 0, 0]:\n        break\n    else:\n        case.append(test)\n\nfor i, (L, P, V) in enumerate(case):\n    total = V // P * L\n    if V % P >= L:\n        total += L\n    else:\n        total += (V % P)\n    print(f\"Case {i+1}: {total}\")\n"}]}]
